identity: Stormvault Heights is The Accord's high road to the front: Borin keeps the work crews fed and equipped, Alna restores a reliable watch over their routes, and Split-Seam threatens the high paths.

quests.title: Words Worth Bringing Back
quests.text: My observers send word when a crew returns, changes watch or needs relief; a missing message can leave the next crew waiting in the wrong place. The Waylayers at {name:slatehook}, {dir_from_giver:slatehook}, have been taking those messages off our runners. Bring me a Runner's Packet from them. I would like to plan a watch with information newer than the watch itself.

variants.text: My observers send word when a crew returns, changes watch or needs relief; a missing message can leave the next crew waiting in the wrong place. The Waylayers at {name:slatehook}, {dir_from_giver:slatehook}, have been taking those messages off our runners. Bring me a Runner's Packet from them. I would like to plan a watch with information newer than the watch itself.

A shift report tells me who is still out there and who ought to be home. The Hedge Bowmen at {name:coalbrand_yard}, {dir_from_giver:coalbrand_yard}, have been taking our runners' messages. Recover a Runner's Packet and bring it to me. Someone is waiting to hear that their crew got back.

The Bandit Fletchers at {name:rootsnare}, {dir_from_giver:rootsnare}, steal the carriers' messages as readily as they cut our roots for arrow shafts. Those messages tell us which crews have returned and which still need supplies. Bring me a Runner's Packet from the camp. A path is little use if the people at either end cannot hear from one another.

A crew can come home and still be listed as missing if the word never reaches us. The Shroud Archers at {name:pallcloth_den}, {dir_from_giver:pallcloth_den}, have been intercepting those return messages. Bring me a Runner's Packet from them. I would rather welcome someone once than write an apology after their memorial.

The Trench Archers at {name:sunderstrap_camp}, {dir_from_giver:sunderstrap_camp}, are stealing our runners' messages. Somewhere in that camp is a Runner's Packet full of questions about deliveries that never arrived. Bring one back to me. The people asking have waited long enough for an answer.

My carriers send word of a finished run so the next crew knows when to set out. The Brigand Bowmen at {name:rainchar_camp}, {dir_from_giver:rainchar_camp}, have taken to keeping that word for themselves. Bring me a Runner's Packet from them. A drum can tell the whole forest that a crew is coming home; it is much worse at saying which one.

quests.lesson: A shared quest drop from the bandit archers of the zone's Round 20 bandit camp (an area per variant); a potion choice (given in all six zones, so no armor: the reward budget).
quests.notes: Round 61 BANDQUESTS. Draft §3 'Words Worth Bringing Back' (K10 A): the Runner's Packet, a soulbound quest-only item (local messages, no proof of the front's plot), drops 1 in 3 from the camp's archers while needed; the area keeps Blackwind's hideout archers out. Done once everywhere: no other text claims a second camp.

quests.title: A Proper Introduction to Rock
quests.text: The stone here sends picks back with their teeth missing, and I am running short of replacements. Bring me four Silversteel Bars for the station's picks; Steel Bars and Silver Bars go together in a Dual Furnace. I will see that the next introduction leaves a mark on the rock.
quests.lesson: A local task; the first armor choice (one enchant, a prefix).
quests.notes: Round 61 BANDQUESTS. The id stays (its objectives are unchanged); free, it requires nothing.

quests.title: A Supper with Fins
quests.text: The station's cook has started naming the different ways to serve the same ration. Bring me four Frostfin before he reaches the end of the list and starts again. A crew that works this hard ought to have something to look forward to when the tools go down.
quests.lesson: An early errand, a level only; the zone's potion choice.
quests.notes: Round 61 BANDQUESTS. Free play, a level only.

quests.title: Word for Cinderline Watch
quests.text: Toren Waterbarrel at Cinderline Watch in Ashenward March feeds the drivers who bring our supplies. He needs help keeping those loads moving, and I need my workers to eat. Go and speak to him; a sound road is not much use without something worth carrying on it.
quests.lesson: A travel quest, free (a level only).
quests.notes: Round 61 BANDQUESTS. The id stays (its objectives are unchanged); free, it requires nothing.

quests.title: Alna Needs Good Eyes
quests.text: Alna Archsight at Archshadow Post needs help with her observations before the next loads go out. Speak to her if you can tell a loose stone from a solid one without waiting for it to land. She is particular about reports, but being wrong up here tends to make a dent.
quests.lesson: A travel quest, free (a level only).
quests.notes: Round 61 BANDQUESTS. The id stays (its objectives are unchanged); free, it requires nothing.

quests.title: A Clearer View of Trouble
quests.text: Our new sights have every fitting except the one that matters. Bring me two Emberglass so we can finish them. 'Something moved' is a fine beginning to a report; I would like my observers to manage the rest.
quests.lesson: A local task; the second armor choice (one enchant, a suffix).
quests.notes: Round 61 BANDQUESTS. The id stays (its objectives are unchanged); free, it requires nothing.

quests.title: A Reliable Stand
quests.text: The observers working the {name:highcrags} need a fixed reference, and our sighting frame has shifted on its stand. Go to the {name:survey_stand}, {dir_from_giver:survey_stand}, and set the frame back on its marks. We can argue over what moved once our own equipment stops joining in.
quests.completion: Good, the observers can compare their readings from the same marks again. That should remove at least one wandering mountain from the reports.
quests.lesson: The zone's solo quest; the weapon choice (prefix and suffix).
quests.notes: Round 61 BANDQUESTS. K6 A: the zone's solo quest with its weapon, at a new recipe place in the Highcrags.

quests.title: Party: A Crack Is Not a Weakness
quests.text: {name:split_seam_warden} is battering the work paths in the {name:stormcrags}, and the split in its stone has encouraged some very poor judgement. Gather a group and bring it down, {dir_from_giver:split_seam_warden}. A crack you can see is not necessarily a crack you can put a pick through.
quests.lesson: The optional group quest: free, standalone, a trinket choice as its extra.
quests.notes: Round 61 BANDQUESTS. The optional group quest (round61-plan.md §2 point 8): free, standalone, a trinket choice as its extra; the survey stand needs neither its kill nor its spot.

quests.title: What the Watch Needs to Know
quests.text: Nella Hedgeward at Last Hedge Redoubt in Ashenward March needs help with the fighting beyond our frontier posts. Speak to her about the work. She wants to know what her next patrol will face, and she listens closely to whoever has to walk there.
quests.lesson: A travel quest, free (a level only).
quests.notes: Round 61 BANDQUESTS. The departure at 40 (round61-plan.md §2 point 7): Alna's own front quests start at 44.

quests.title: The Cost of Holding Ground
quests.text: The guild has checked the report of your camp raid: cargo bearing our marks was stacked for the enemy's building work. The Throng took it in an open attack on our transport, and the crews it belonged to still need replacements. Take the combined report to Nella Hedgeward at Last Hedge Redoubt in Ashenward March. You have set their building work back; she can help us put the next load into our own workers' hands.
quests.completion: The drivers on this report are due relief, and their crews still need the tools that were taken. The Charter of Stone and I will arrange the replacements and a watch to protect the next delivery along that route. Speak to the Warmaster at Ashenward Bastion; you have brought me an account I can act on, and I want the Bastion to hear it too.

variants.text: The guild has checked the report of your camp raid: cargo bearing our marks was stacked for the enemy's building work. The Throng took it in an open attack on our transport, and the crews it belonged to still need replacements. Take the combined report to Nella Hedgeward at Last Hedge Redoubt in Ashenward March. You have set their building work back; she can help us put the next load into our own workers' hands.

I have matched the report of your camp raid to our transport losses: the cargo set aside for the enemy's building work bears our marks. The Throng seized it in an open attack on the transport; the drivers whose record you brought me saved what they could. Take these findings to Nella Hedgeward at Last Hedge Redoubt. I have added the replacement tools and relief those crews still need, so she can plan the next delivery with us.

The report of your camp raid has reached us, and the guild has matched the cargo marks at that building site to our lost supplies. The Throng took those goods in an open attack on our transport and laid them aside for its own construction. Carry the combined report to Nella Hedgeward at Last Hedge Redoubt in Ashenward March. The attack you made has bought our crews some room to work; let us see they have the tools and protection to use it.

quests.lesson: Chapter 3 of the story arc (story, may chain): a travel from any band foreman of the faction.
quests.notes: Round 61 BANDQUESTS. A6 (story, 39): requires A5 and the free camp raid (its one Accord follow-up); any of the three Accord band foremen gives it (a raid elsewhere counts).

quests.title: Who Was on the Cart
quests.text: The silver and sapphire orders are filled; I also have a border report that lists the drivers and workers affected by our lost loads. Bring the border report to Hadrin Beamset at the Miner's Guild house in Dur Brannoc for The Charter of Stone.
quests.completion: Good, the drivers and workers have their own lines beside the lost loads. The Charter of Stone gathers these border reports so we can find out who needs tools, relief or a safer way through. A cargo total alone will not tell us that.

variants.text: The silver and sapphire orders are filled; I also have a border report that lists the drivers and workers affected by our lost loads. Bring the border report to Hadrin Beamset at the Miner's Guild house in Dur Brannoc for The Charter of Stone.
variants.completion: Good, the drivers and workers have their own lines beside the lost loads. The Charter of Stone gathers these border reports so we can find out who needs tools, relief or a safer way through. A cargo total alone will not tell us that.

variants.text: Our silver and sapphire are accounted for, but this border report still needs a hearing: it names the drivers and workers behind the lost cargo. Bring the border report to Alis Cartwright at the Miner's Guild house in Highcourt for The Charter of Stone.
variants.completion: I can see which drivers lost their loads and which workers were left without supplies. That is why The Charter of Stone asks for news from the border. Now I can plan the next delivery around the people waiting for it.

variants.text: Both orders are settled; this report names the drivers and workers affected by cargo lost at the border, so the guild can see the whole cost. Bring the camp report to Caelir Veinward at the Miner's Guild house in Lethariel for The Charter of Stone.
variants.completion: The names show where a lost load has left work unfinished and people exposed. The Charter of Stone keeps these border reports so the next supply plan can account for both. I will preserve the workers' and drivers' entries with the cargo record.

variants.text: The silver and sapphire orders are filled; I have also finished a border report with every affected driver and worker entered beside the lost loads. Bring the border report to Hadrin Beamset at the Miner's Guild house in Dur Brannoc for The Charter of Stone.
variants.completion: Good, the drivers and workers have their own lines beside the lost loads. The Charter of Stone gathers these border reports so we can find out who needs tools, relief or a safer way through. A cargo total alone will not tell us that.

variants.text: Both orders are settled, and I can spare a moment for this border report; the lost cargo has its line, and so do the drivers and workers left short. Bring the border report to Alis Cartwright at the Miner's Guild house in Highcourt for The Charter of Stone.
variants.completion: I can see which drivers lost their loads and which workers were left without supplies. That is why The Charter of Stone asks for news from the border. Now I can plan the next delivery around the people waiting for it.

variants.text: The silver and sapphire are accounted for; this border report also gives the names of the drivers and workers affected by the loads that never arrived. Bring the border report to Alis Cartwright at the Miner's Guild house in Highcourt for The Charter of Stone.
variants.completion: I can see which drivers lost their loads and which workers were left without supplies. That is why The Charter of Stone asks for news from the border. Now I can plan the next delivery around the people waiting for it.

variants.text: Both orders are filled, and I have a border report ready that names the drivers and workers affected by the missing supplies. Bring the border report to Caelir Veinward at the Miner's Guild house in Lethariel for The Charter of Stone.
variants.completion: The names show where a lost load has left work unfinished and people exposed. The Charter of Stone keeps these border reports so the next supply plan can account for both. I will preserve the workers' and drivers' entries with the cargo record.

quests.notes: Round 58 follow-up of tier 4 (The Charter of Stone): story seed: A short camp report names the affected drivers and workers beside the lost cargo and shows why the guild collects news from the border.

quests.title: Keep the Loads Moving
quests.text: Stormhorn Rams keep meeting our supply carriers on the crags, and neither party has learned to give way. Hunt eight Stormhorn Rams by day on the {name:eagle_crags}, which lie {zone_area:eagle_crags}. I trust our workers' footing more when nothing is trying to knock it out from under them.

variants.text: Stormhorn Rams keep meeting our supply carriers on the crags, and neither party has learned to give way. Hunt eight Stormhorn Rams by day on the {name:eagle_crags}, which lie {zone_area:eagle_crags}. I trust our workers' footing more when nothing is trying to knock it out from under them.

Ashwolves have started following the workers who bring our camp supplies through the woods. Hunt eight Ashwolves by day in the {name:cinderwood}, which lies {zone_area:cinderwood}. The Accord needs these loads, and I need the people carrying them to come back.

Rootantlers have been charging our wood carriers along the forest fringe. Hunt eight Rootantlers by day in the {name:fringe}, which lies {zone_area:fringe}. I allowed for care around the roots in our schedule; being chased through them was not included.

Muster Husks keep marching into our supply crews as if the loads ought to make way for them. Defeat eight Muster Husks by day in the {name:badlands}, which lie {zone_area:badlands}. The Throng has living and dead workers worth protecting, and all of them have better work to do.

quests.notes: Round 58 camp hunt: one shared quest per camp band and clock, given by the camps' foremen; a role near the camp (the camps' level belt L31-33) that the zone's own quests do not hunt yet, met by day.

quests.title: Before the Stakes Take Root
quests.text: The Throng is building the {name:camp_site_stormvault_heights} {dir_from_giver:camp_site_stormvault_heights}, staking out our contested ground while we are busy keeping loads moving. Defeat four Throng Stakeguards and {captain:camp_site_stormvault_heights} at the construction camp. The Charter of Stone supplies The Accord's army, and we cannot afford an enemy post watching every delivery.

variants.text: The Throng is building the {name:camp_site_stormvault_heights} {dir_from_giver:camp_site_stormvault_heights}, staking out our contested ground while we are busy keeping loads moving. Defeat four Throng Stakeguards and {captain:camp_site_stormvault_heights} at the construction camp. The Charter of Stone supplies The Accord's army, and we cannot afford an enemy post watching every delivery.

The Throng is putting up the {name:camp_site_ashenward_march} {dir_from_giver:camp_site_ashenward_march} on our contested ground, with a fine view of the trouble it can cause us. Defeat four Throng Stakeguards and {captain:camp_site_ashenward_march} at the construction camp. The Charter of Stone has loads promised to The Accord's army, and an enemy camp next door will not help them arrive.

The Throng is driving stakes for the {name:camp_site_glassroot_wilds} {dir_from_giver:camp_site_glassroot_wilds}, claiming our contested ground one post at a time. Defeat four Throng Stakeguards and {captain:camp_site_glassroot_wilds} at the construction camp. The Charter of Stone keeps The Accord's army supplied; an enemy foothold in these woods will make that work dearer for everyone.

The Accord is raising the {name:camp_site_blackwind_rise} {dir_from_giver:camp_site_blackwind_rise} on our contested ground, and I have no intention of letting them settle in comfortably. Defeat four Accord Stakeguards and {captain:camp_site_blackwind_rise} at the construction camp. The Oathdelvers have pledged these loads to The Throng, and our haulers have enough hazards without a new enemy post.

The Accord is building the {name:camp_site_bannerbreak_mesa} {dir_from_giver:camp_site_bannerbreak_mesa} on our contested ground. Defeat four Accord Stakeguards and {captain:camp_site_bannerbreak_mesa} at the construction camp before they get too comfortable. The Oathdelvers keep their word to The Throng's army, and that gets harder with an enemy camp at our elbow.

The Accord has started the {name:camp_site_thunderroot_wilds} {dir_from_giver:camp_site_thunderroot_wilds}, driving its claim into our contested ground. Defeat four Accord Stakeguards and {captain:camp_site_thunderroot_wilds} at the construction camp. The Oathdelvers promised supplies to The Throng's fighters, and I will not leave our porters to carry them past a growing enemy post.

quests.notes: Round 58 raid: the camp under construction of each contested T4 zone, given by the own T4 foreman; its four guards and its captain, as a war camp's raid.

quests.title: Stormkelp for the Field Kits
quests.text: My field kits are laid out for the next working parties, but I am short of one of the ingredients. Bring me eight Stormkelp; I will handle the preparation. It is much easier to finish a kit here than explain an empty compartment to someone who needs it.

variants.text: My field kits are laid out for the next working parties, but I am short of one of the ingredients. Bring me eight Stormkelp; I will handle the preparation. It is much easier to finish a kit here than explain an empty compartment to someone who needs it.

The recovery parties need field kits packed before they leave, and mine are waiting on Stormkelp. Bring me eight, and I will prepare it for them. I take good care of what comes back, but I would rather send fewer belongings home without their owners.

quests.lesson: A free front task of the giver's own people (a level only).
quests.notes: Round 62 FRONTQUESTS. Draft F7: the host processes it; the second armor choice of Stormvault and Blackwind.

quests.title: Party: Close the Toll
quests.text: {name:last_toll_construct} holds the {name:front_broken_causeway/toll_fields} on The Broken Causeway, threatening even travellers with nothing worth taking. Gather a group and break that elite construct, {dir_from_giver:last_toll_construct}. This is a separate undertaking for a prepared party; the repair crews have work enough without being sent under its feet.

variants.text: {name:last_toll_construct} holds the {name:front_broken_causeway/toll_fields} on The Broken Causeway, threatening even travellers with nothing worth taking. Gather a group and break that elite construct, {dir_from_giver:last_toll_construct}. This is a separate undertaking for a prepared party; the repair crews have work enough without being sent under its feet.

{name:last_toll_construct} stalks the {name:front_broken_causeway/toll_fields} on The Broken Causeway, leaving travellers in need of recovery rather than a crossing. A willing group could do us a service by destroying it, {dir_from_giver:last_toll_construct}. Take a party fit to face an elite; I would like this particular recovery job to begin and end with pieces of the construct.

quests.lesson: An optional group quest: free, standalone, a trinket choice as its extra.
